text:
maria: Quick ping — PR #4217: onprem auth sidecar + secret mount changes pushed. Need security eyes before I merge. TL;DR: move secret path, add small SA scope change, opt into KMS path if available. @jess @chris :eyes:
security-bot: SecretScan: no plaintext secrets found. Diff adds 2 new env vars flagged for review: KMS_ENDPOINT and KMS_KEY_ID. See report: https://internal/reports/scan/4217
jess: Looking now. Curious — why switch from projected_sa to file-mount for creds? onprem ops prefers projected tokens to rotate automatically.
maria: Good q. Projected token wasn't compatible with the sidecar binary (it expects file path), and fixing that would take more time. Mount allows faster rollout. We can add a rotation sidecar later.
alex: Can we narrow the SA scope? The PR grants storage.read on all buckets. Suggest `storage.read:resource:prefix:customer-data/*` instead.
maria: Yep. Updated to narrow scope in the last commit — see diff. I left a TODO to wire KMS usage only for regulated tenants.
chris: About VPC egress — this onprem instance will need to talk to our KMS; is that routed over private link or public egress? Ops?
ops-bot: Network note: instance is in customer VPC peered via transit; KMS must be reachable over peering or an edge NAT. If public, we need egress rule on firewall for ksm.redwood-internal:443
jess: If KMS endpoint is public, we need egress approval doc and ensure TLS pinning. Also confirm HSM key usage vs KMS cleartext.
maria: Agree. For now I toggled KMS off by default in config and left env var opt-in. Can we get a quick security signoff on the scope + rotation plan? If ok I'll merge into canary tomorrow morning.
jess: :thumbsup: LGTM for scope narrowing and opt-in KMS. Please add a short note in the PR description about rotation plan and fallback behavior.
alex: :shipit: once PR desc updated. tag me on merge.
maria: Done — PR desc updated with rotation plan and fallback. Merging after 09:00 PT canary window. Thanks all :tada:
